response.justification: Experienced and versatile senior engineer with 15+ years across web, backend, and some embedded work, but the profile is a poor match for a C++-centric industrial automation role. Hands-on C/C++ experience is limited to a ~7-month stint at National Instruments (2014–2015) and an academic project; the rest of the career is JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang. There is no evidence of STL-heavy modern C++, message-broker/event-driven C++ systems, MQTT/Modbus/OPC UA protocols, IEC 62443 or Secure Development Lifecycle practice, or industrial automation domain exposure. Strengths in low-latency distributed systems (Dunnhumby/Sociomantic) and testing culture are transferable but do not cover the core technical and security requirements.
strengths: Deep experience with low-latency, high-throughput distributed and event-driven systems
Strong engineering craft: TDD, CI/CD, tooling, open-source libraries, mentoring and teaching
Broad full-stack range including Node.js, React-adjacent frontend, Docker/Kubernetes deployments
concerns: Minimal recent C++/STL experience; primary languages are TypeScript and DLang
No industrial automation, IoT protocol (MQTT/Modbus/OPC UA), or IEC 62443/SDL security background
No demonstrated architecture ownership in on-prem industrial platforms or UML/documentation practice
